summary: The live synthetic Workbench preview resolves both prior design findings. The ToolCall summary has no border and uses the shared 24px success badge; the result preview retains its own 1px boundary and declares ko-KR. Layout and wrapping remained legible without horizontal overflow at 320×720, 390×800, 600×800, 900×800, and 1280×800. The inert preview has no link role or keyboard stop. Speaker and event provenance, loading/error copy, and malformed-result fallback were also inspected in source.
limits: Review covers a static synthetic fixture and source inspection. Live streaming, permission cards, real SDK behavior, runtime error and recovery states, dark mode, 200% zoom, and screen-reader output were not tested. The running server bundle was not independently attested to the source hash.
